findings.checklist_item: - [ ] In the Verification section, scope each probe oracle as either an authoritative observation of Pydantic AI 1.107.2 runtime behavior or an operator-synthesized input (esp. for provider-server-side scenarios like bug 895c native-output/grammar rejection and content-filter finish_reasons), and require the decision matrix to mark provider-server-side behaviors as unmeasurable-offline rather than preserve/change.
evidence: Verification: 'mocking only provider transport'; probe scenarios include 'provider errors, truncation/refusal'

src/rebar/llm/structured.py lines 262-289 show provider server-side rejection behavior (bug 895c botocore outputConfig; native grammar bound to 'avoid the provider's grammar-compilation rejection') — server-side conditions a FunctionModel cannot reproduce
ABSENCE: plan does not distinguish oracles that authoritatively observe Pydantic AI runtime behavior from those that only replay operator-crafted error inputs
findings.finding: The offline FunctionModel/mocked-transport probe cannot reproduce provider server-side behaviors (Bedrock/botocore native-output rejection per bug 895c, provider grammar-compilation rejection, content-filter finish_reasons) that encode much of Rebar's hard-won behavior; it can only observe Pydantic AI's HANDLING of operator-synthesized error inputs. The plan lists 'provider errors, truncation/refusal' as probe scenarios without scoping which oracles are authoritative observations of Pydantic AI 1.107.2 vs. operator-fabricated inputs, so a 'provider error' scenario could be mislabeled preserve/intentionally-change when its provider-native behavior is simply unmeasurable offline.
findings.location: Plan > Verification; Plan bullet 'Continue or create the checkout-local ... provider errors, truncation/refusal'
scenarios: A Bedrock/botocore native-output rejection scenario is classified preserve/change from a synthesized FunctionModel response rather than an observed provider behavior
A content-filter/truncation finish_reason delta is attributed to Pydantic AI when it was operator-fabricated in the probe
